svg.title: Conversational Analytics Workbench
svg.desc: The Conversational Analytics Workbench logo for dark backgrounds: a white circular conversation ring with rising analytics bars, beside the project name in white. The header shows the tagline as text beside it, because at header size it would be too small to read.

g.font-family: Inter, SF Pro Display, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
